system.description:
A disciplined warrior who fights with style and grace. They could be a daring swashbuckler or a noble practicing an established style. They specialize in darting among their foes with flair, waiting for the right chance to take them down.

The Fencer is a great class for those who prize mobility. Most of their skills have them shift around the battlefield and sometimes require them to be in specific rows before activating powerful effects.
triggers: You prove your skill to an audience.
You challenge someone to a duel.
You spare your defeated opponent in a duel.
complications: You are challenged to a duel you can't refuse.
Someone important asks you to be their champion.
